# Monaco Editor (vendored)

Bundled [Monaco Editor](https://github.com/microsoft/monaco-editor) **0.52.0** (`min/vs` + `min-maps`) for offline use and CSP-friendly deployments.

Source maps live in the sibling `../min-maps/` directory (paths expected by Monaco's minified bundles).

To refresh:

```bash
./scripts/vendor-monaco.sh
```
